import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Hundebestand Analyse - Zürich', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of dog breeds (top 10)
breed_counts = pd.concat([
    df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts(),
    df['Rasse2Text'].dropna().value_counts()
]).groupby(level=0).sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='steelblue')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Anzahl', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Hunderassen', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()

# 2. Dog age distribution
age_dist = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(age_dist)), age_dist.values, color='coral')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(age_dist)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_dist.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Altersverteilung der Hunde', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Distribution by Kreis
kreis_dist = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(kreis_dist)), kreis_dist.values, color='lightgreen')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(kreis_dist)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(kreis_dist.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Verteilung nach Stadtkreis', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Rassentypen distribution
rassentyp = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(rassentyp)))
axes[1, 1].pie(rassentyp.values, labels=rassentyp.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors, startangle=90)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Verteilung Rassentypen', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
